verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-260820-788 dated 2026-08-20 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony DC Hamburg, referencing POs 4500318689 and 4500318691. It lists 14 PCS of CMP-GAM-010 (2 packages) and 16 PCS of CMP-GAM-006 (16 packages). The package total of 18 matches the stated 件数 of 18. Gross weight is 180 kg and the carrier is Nordhav Shipping A/S. It carries a DC-HAM RECEIVED stamp dated 25.09.2026 and a handwritten receiver signature 'Meyer K.'. There are no corrections or strike-throughs.
observations: Quantities are printed as '14.000' and '16.000'. They are read as 14 and 16 under the Chinese decimal convention, which fits the 2 and 16 packages and the 180 kg gross weight.
The description of CMP-GAM-010 is cut off in print after 'die-cast, 18'.
Both POs are listed in the header, but the lines are not mapped to individual POs.
The note shows no ordered quantity, so delivered quantities cannot be compared with the orders from this document.
The blue DC-HAM RECEIVED stamp reads 25.09.2026 and is slightly rotated but clear.
The receiver signature 'Meyer K.' is handwritten in blue ink on the 收货签字 line.
The remarks field (备注) is blank.
